The Battle Circus is a facility for
Single, Double, and Multi Battle<0xFA>challenges.<0xFB>Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Circus<0xFA>Ringmaster, or you choose to rest.<0xFB>In Single Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with three or<0xFA>six Pokémon.<0xFB>In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or six<0xFA>Pokémon.<0xFB>The battles are held in the main
arena.<0xFB>Before each battle, the Ringmaster
will activate a random effect for<0xFA>the duration of the battle.<0xFB>This effect is permanent and cannot
be removed or overridden.<0xFB>These effects may also increase in
intensity and begin to stack the<0xFA>higher your streak becomes.<0xFB>For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Battle Points<0xFC><0x01><0x08> (<0xFC><0x01><0x06>BP<0xFC><0x01><0x08>).<0xFB>If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be<0xFA>recorded for when you wish to<0xFA>continue.<0xFB>If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified<0xFA>from your challenge.<0xFB>Please be aware of that!

entries.canonical_english:
The Battle Circus is a facility for
Single, Double, and Multi Battle<0xFA>challenges.<0xFB>Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Circus<0xFA>Ringmaster, or you choose to rest.<0xFB>The Battle Circus' Multi Battle
show is for Multi Battles with a<0xFA>partner.<0xFB>To enter, join another Trainer and
compete with two or three Pokémon<0xFA>each.<0xFB>Underneath the circus is a room
named the Battle Salon where you<0xFA>can meet other Trainers.<0xFB>There you can find a Trainer to act
as your partner in the Multi<0xFA>Battles.<0xFB>You can also partner up with a
friend using a Link Cable.<0xFB>Once you have partnered up, you
will be shown to the main arena.<0xFB>In the arena, tag teams will
challenge you.<0xFB>Before each battle, the Ringmaster
will activate a random effect for<0xFA>the duration of the battle.<0xFB>This effect is permanent and cannot
be removed or overridden.<0xFB>These effects may also increase in
intensity and begin to stack the<0xFA>higher your streak becomes.<0xFB>If you manage to defeat each team,
you will earn Battle Points (BP).<0xFB>If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be<0xFA>recorded for when you wish to<0xFA>continue.<0xFB>If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified<0xFA>from your challenge.<0xFB>Also, if you are in a tag team with
a friend, you may not interrupt<0xFA>your challenge.<0xFB>Please be aware of that!
